title: Wooden Overcoats
subtitle: A funeral-home sitcom full of vanity, sabotage, and immaculate comic timing.
description: A British comedy fiction series about dueling funeral directors, escalating grudges, and a village small enough for every petty disaster to feel personal.

length.label: Apple lists 55 episodes and years active 2015-2024; the official site also promoted additional 2025 material.

archiveTake: A strong next stop when the listener wants ensemble comedy with sharper jokes than warmth-first comfort.

similarReasons.wolf-359: Keeps the ensemble friction and running bit energy alive in a bigger sci-fi frame.
similarReasons.oz-9: Pushes the incompetence and comic disaster angle much harder.
similarReasons.eos-10: Another banter-heavy ensemble comedy route with a lighter speculative wrapper.
